fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide stories.rss feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle, article-mode).

name.title: Name
name.description: Duplicate of headline as emitted by the JSON-LD NewsArticle node (article-mode).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD; latest-mode from the RSS <description>).

alternativeHeadline.title: Alternative headline
alternativeHeadline.description: Alternate headline field from JSON-LD, observed empty on every sample (article-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article content from the upstream JSON-LD NewsArticle node (article-mode). QUIRK: this HTML markup (

tags) is HTML-entity-escaped a second time by upstream, e.g. literal '<p>' instead of '

' -- passed through exactly as served; apply html.unescape() downstream if you want clean HTML/plain text.

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 creation date, as emitted by JSON-LD (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article-mode: list of Person object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- givenName/name/url; observed as a single desk byline like 'NH Political Bureau' or 'NH Digital', not always a named reporter). Latest-mode: plain byline name string from the RSS feed's atom:author/atom:name.

authorUrl.title: Author URL
authorUrl.description: Author profile path from the RSS feed's atom:author/atom:uri (latest-mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: QUIRK: on every sampled article this is a near-empty stub, {'@type': 'Organization', '@context': 'http://schema.org', 'id': ''} -- no real publisher name/logo. Passed through as-is (article-mode).

image.title: Image
image.description: Article-mode: a single ImageObject dict (url/width/height) from JSON-LD -- NOT a list on this site. Latest-mode: single lead-image URL string from the RSS feed's media:content.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail image URL (article-mode, from JSON-LD -- same URL as image.url on every sample).

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Thumbnail image URL, smaller crop (latest-mode, from the RSS feed's media:thumbnail).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section/category name from the RSS <category> tag (latest-mode).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword/tag string (article-mode from JSON-LD; latest-mode from the RSS feed's media:keywords).

url.title: URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted by JSON-LD (article-mode).

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description:
Full article body as clean HTML markup (

tags, NOT double-escaped, unlike article-mode's articleBody), from the RSS feed's content:encoded element (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
